page_title: LIV 2-2 ARS | Liverpool v Arsenal 11/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+8' Celebrations are cut short for Liverpool as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review due to a foul in the build-up play.
90+7' Possible change! There could be a foul by the attacking team in the lead up. Referee Anthony Taylor wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
90+7' Goal! No, wait. It's disallowed for a foul by Andrew Robertson (Liverpool).
90+7' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Liverpool.
90+6' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Liverpool force a corner. They send men into the box.
90+5' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) attempts to find Darwin Nunez, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
90+3' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
90+2' Mohamed Salah passes to Harvey Elliott (Liverpool), but he produces a wild shot from the edge of the box which goes high over the bar.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is furious with himself as he misses a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.
89' This shall not pass! Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
88' Mikel Arteta has decided to substitute Bukayo Saka and he is replaced by Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal).
86' The linesman raises his flag. Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) is adjudged offside.
84' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the right post. Terrific solo effort, though.
83' The referee signals a substitution. Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) is brought on as a substitute for Ryan Gravenberch.
82' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) produces a good shot from the resulting free kick. His effort, however, goes just wide of the left post.
81' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
79' Mikel Merino (Arsenal) is sent off! He justly receives a yellow card and it is his second one, a red card must be given. The match ends for him.
79' Mikel Merino (Arsenal) makes a slide tackle, but referee Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Diogo Jota (Liverpool) comes onto the pitch so that Luis Diaz can be given a rest.
78' Mikel Arteta decides to make a substitution. Ben White will be replaced by Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal).
78' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Kieran Tierney.
77' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
76' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) bursts into the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends a poor shot well past the right post.
73' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
70' 2 - 2 Mikel Merino (Arsenal) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.

70' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) latches on to a pin-point pass on the edge of the box and slashes the ball into the top right corner, but the goalkeeper performs an amazing acrobatic dive to deny him. The strike bounces off his gloves and hits the post.
70' Alisson is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Martin Odegaard (Arsenal). Easy save!
67' Arne Slot prepares a substitution. Curtis Jones is replaced by Darwin Nunez (Liverpool).
67' Conor Bradley will be replaced by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool).
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cody Gakpo leaves the pitch and Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) comes on.
66' William Saliba (Arsenal) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player.
65' A quickly taken corner by Arsenal.
64' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Arsenal.

63' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) was in a good shooting position just outside the box and unleashed a first-time shot towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper made a decent save to thwart his effort.

61' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) clutches his head in despair after blowing a huge opportunity! He receives the ball after the free kick and takes good first touch to unleash a low shot from close range, but Alisson makes a nice save.
60' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
59' Arsenal are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

56' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. David Raya makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.

55' Ben White (Arsenal) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Alisson makes a decent save to deny his effort directed low to the middle of the target.
54' A pass from Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is intercepted by David Raya and the move breaks down.

53' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) loses the defending players and unloads a powerful, but inaccurate effort from long distance. The goalkeeper remains completely calm as the ball ends somewhere in row Z.
53' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and David Raya comes off his line to intercept.
52' Bukayo Saka races towards the box before laying off to Leandro Trossard (Arsenal), who picks it up but blazes a shot well over the bar from the edge of the box.
51' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked.
50' Ben White (Arsenal) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

47' 2 - 1 Goal – 2:1! Leandro Trossard sends a precise lofted pass into the box, Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) rises above the defenders to meet the ball near the penalty spot and heads it straight into the bottom right corner.
46' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar.
45+4' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
45+3' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.

45+3' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
45+2' Mikel Merino (Arsenal) plays a through ball but overhits it.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
43' Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.

42' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
41' David Raya is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool). Easy save!
37' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
34' Mikel Merino (Arsenal) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
33' A cross from Mikel Merino (Arsenal) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
31' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
30' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes high over the bar.
29' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
28' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.

27' Thomas Partey (Arsenal) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a free kick to Liverpool, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
26' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
25' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner kick, but David Raya reads it well and stops the effort.

24' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the left-hand post, but David Raya was alert and the score remains the same. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
24' Mikel Merino (Arsenal) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
21' 2 - 0 Goal! Dominik Szoboszlai passes the ball to the feet of Luis Diaz (Liverpool), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 2:0.

20' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) makes it 1:0. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Andrew Robertson and planted his close-range header into the left side of the goal. David Raya was helpless.
17' The goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to deny Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) as he jumps for a header from a brilliant cross into the penalty area.
14' Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Anthony Taylor stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
12' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Arsenal.

8' It's unbelievable, Luis Diaz (Liverpool) blows a huge opportunity! He is totally unmarked and fires a first-time shot towards goal from a few yards out, but David Raya reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
7' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

7' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
4' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) should have done it better. He won the ball from the resulting free kick, but fired well wide of the left post.
2' Anthony Taylor interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool).
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Arsenal will kick-off.
Anthony Taylor will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
Show lineups
